title: Baseline
description: A reference measurement or established starting condition against which change, improvement, or deterioration can be evaluated (CR-MET-006).

external_references.description: CR-3P: identifiers in external systems. Never a substitute for the OpenDEA id (E004).

reference_metric_ref.description: The PerformanceMetric id this Baseline is a reference for (relationship dea:references).

subject_ref.description: The subject the Baseline concerns (relationship dea:applies-to; target is Entity or AssessmentSubject).

reference_value.description: The reference value or observation summary. Numeric for ratio/interval Metrics; ordinal for ordinal Metrics; categorical for categorical Metrics.

applicable_period.description: Reference to a TemporalInterval; CR-MET-006 binding.

organizational_scope.description: The organizational scope (enterprise, business_domain, business_unit, capability, process, product_or_service, system). String or array of strings.

source_evidence.description: Source and evidence supporting the Baseline. String or array of strings/references.

supersedes_baselines.description: Previous Baseline ids this Baseline supersedes (relationship dea:supersedes, extended in CR-MET-004).
